cases.claim_text: A calendar year is exactly 365.25 days long.
cases.gold_claim_span: A calendar year is exactly 365.25 days long.

gold_evidence_spans.quoted_text: Earth takes about 365.2422 days to make one revolution around the Sun.
year, calendar: ... either 365 or 366 days. year, Julian: a period of 365.25 days.

ambiguity_notes: An ordinary civil-calendar year contains 365 or 366 days.
Exactly 365.25 days applies to the Julian-year convention, not every meaning of calendar year.

cases.claim_text: Pure water always boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
cases.gold_claim_span: Pure water always boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

gold_evidence_spans.quoted_text: The boiling point of water increases by about 30 mK if the pressure is increased by 10^-3 atm.
On ITS-90, the atmospheric boiling temperature of water turns out to be approximately 373.124 K (99.974 degrees Celsius).
Because of the normal decrease of barometric pressure with height, the nominal boiling point of water decreases.

ambiguity_notes: The word “always” is contradicted because boiling temperature depends on pressure.
Even at atmospheric pressure, the cited ITS-90 value is approximately 99.974°C rather than exactly 100°C.

cases.claim_text: Every adult human has exactly 206 bones.
cases.gold_claim_span: Every adult human has exactly 206 bones.

gold_evidence_spans.quoted_text: Human infants typically have 270 bones, fusing into around 206 in the human adult. Variability in number arises from some bones' anatomic variations.
Accessory ossicles are inconstant, independent, and considered well formed bones

ambiguity_notes: Around 206 is a typical adult count, not a universal exact count.
Anatomic variation and accessory ossicles defeat the quantifier “every.”

an intentionally tiny Napoleon, not an accurate physical proportion
